recentItems.description:

Ibrahim Talibov of Azerbaijan is a Youth Olympic judo champion, defeating Croatia's Jona Žvorc in the final of the men's -55kg category. Mongolia's Tugskhuslen Tungalag and Elisha Zimba of Zambia claimed bronze.
